definitions.explanation: The act of choosing from among alternatives.

examples.japanese: ⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧{選択|せんたく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迫|せま}られた→迫る：03928_semaru⟧。
examples.english: I was forced to make a difficult choice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選択|せんたく}{肢|し}→選択肢：14418_sentakushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦すぎる→すぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{最良|さいりょう}→最良：18491_sairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{選択|せんたく}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think this is the best choice.

notes:
{選択|せんたく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is used as a する-verb meaning "to choose" or "to select."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {選択|せんたく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to select, to choose)
- ⟦{選択|せんたく}{肢|し}→選択肢：14418_sentakushi⟧ (option, alternative)
- {選択|せんたく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{余地|よち}→余地：07612_yochi⟧ (room for choice)
- {選択|せんたく}⟦{科目|かもく}→科目：00163_kamoku⟧ (elective subject)
- {選択|せんたく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迫|せま}られる→迫る：03928_semaru⟧ (to be forced to choose)

HOMOPHONE NOTE:
{選択|せんたく} (selection) vs ⟦{洗濯|せんたく}→洗濯：13283_sentaku⟧ (laundry) - same reading, different kanji and meaning.
